title: [1/7/2023] Number of magazines sold per person
prompt: The chart below shows the number of magazines sold per person in five countries in 2000 and 2010, with projected sales for 2020. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make a comparison where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The bar chart illustrates the number of magazines purchased per capita in five different countries over a 20-year period, from 2000 to 2020, with the last year showing projected figures.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, three countries (A, B and C) showed a declining trend in magazine sales throughout the period, while the remaining two nations experienced growth in their figures. Moreover, country B consistently maintained the highest sales figures among all countries, while country E remained significantly lower than the others throughout the period.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the countries with higher sales figures, in 2000, country B led with 50 magazines per person, slightly higher than country A, at 48 units. Country B then experienced a gradual decline to 47 magazines in 2010 and was forecast to fall further to 45 units by 2020. Meanwhile, country A saw a more significant decrease, dropping to 44 magazines per capita in 2010 and was expected to reach 37 units by the end of the period.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining nations, country C started at 36 magazines per person in 2000, while countries D and E recorded much lower figures of 18 and 4 units, respectively. Country C then showed a slight downward trend, falling to 34 magazines in 2010 and 33 in 2020. In contrast, country D was the only nation to show consistent growth, rising to 20 magazines per person in 2010 and projected to reach 23 units by 2020. Lastly, country E maintained relatively stable but minimal figures throughout the period, with only slight fluctuations between 4 and 7 magazines per capita.
